s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings in the fridge overnight. Bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Melt 60g butter with 80ml hot sauce and 1 tbsp honey and toss. Mix 80g blue cheese into 150g sour cream to dip. Serve with celery sticks.

Halve and seed 12 jalapeños. Mix 150g cream cheese with 60g grated cheddar and fill each half. Wrap in half a rasher of bacon, 12 rashers in total, and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until the bacon is crisp.

m.how: Rub a 2kg brisket with 2 tbsp salt, 2 tbsp cracked pepper and 1 tbsp smoked paprika. Wrap and cook at 140C for 8 hours until it wobbles. Rest an hour and slice thick. Serve with white bread, pickles and barbecue sauce.

w.how: Beat 200g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in a tray at 175C for 30 minutes. Beat 150g butter, 300g icing sugar and 40g cocoa, spread on and cover with sprinkles.

d.how: Chill 3L of American lager in bottles in a big tub of ice for an hour. Pour into red plastic cups and pass them around. Grown-ups only, and someone has to stay sensible.
